 70. Consider recommendations from the Commission on the Status of Women (CSW) 
relating to State legislation affecting women and girls. (ID# 129838) 
Possible action: 
 a. Receive report from CSW. 
 b. Direct Administration to review the recommendations from CSW to support 
Assembly Bills 464, 1876, 1889, 1906, 2563, and Senate Bill 1192, and report to 
the Board as part of the monthly legislative update with options for consideration.
